verses.1: Hallelujah! Praise God in his holy sanctuary; give praise in the mighty dome of heaven.
verses.2: Give praise for his mighty deeds, praise him for his great majesty.
verses.3: Give praise with blasts upon the horn, praise him with harp and lyre.
verses.4: Give praise with tambourines and dance, praise him with flutes and strings.
verses.5: Give praise with crashing cymbals, praise him with sounding cymbals.
verses.6: Let everything that has breath give praise to the LORD! Hallelujah!

notes.text: His holy sanctuary: God's temple on earth. The mighty dome of the heavens: literally, "[God's] strong vault"; heaven is here imagined as a giant plate separating the inhabited world from the waters of the heavens.
